name: Middle-layer Huginn loops beat full-network looping
title: Middle-layer Huginn loops beat full-network looping
summary: A comparison of looped Transformers finds that looping only the middle layers, with separate input and output layers, beats looping the whole network, especially on reasoning. At 8B, Huginn MoE beats Ouro on 8 of 10 benchmarks, uses 75% fewer stored parameters than a compute-matched 32B feedforward MoE, and scores 83.6% on GSM8K versus 80.8%.
